chunks: Aban narrated from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a woman who has a husband and is ṣarūrah, and he does not permit her regarding the hajj. He said: “She performs hajj, even if he does not permit her.”

key_terms.صَرُورَةٌ: a person who has not yet performed the obligatory hajj

ai.seo_question: Does a husband’s permission determine whether his wife may perform the obligatory hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a married woman upon whom the obligatory hajj has become due while she has not yet performed it. It indicates that her husband's refusal does not prevent her from carrying out the obligatory hajj.
